newsitem.title: USA: Heritage Mines names Sparks CEO.
newsitem.headline: Heritage Mines names Sparks CEO.

text.p: Heritage Mines Ltd on Wednesday said it has named mining industry executive Gregory Sparks as its president and chief executive.
In a written statement, the company said it expects Sparks will be named to the board of directors and serve as chairman.
Sparks will replace James Stout, who had been acting president and CEO.

"We have spent six years building the infrastructure to prepare the Bowerman Project (mining district) for exploration and development," Stout said. "We are intensely focused on proving and developing this resource."
